description: This file contains unit tests for Azure Queue Stream filtering functionality within Orleans streaming providers. It defines a test class with fixtures for setting up an Azure testing environment, including configuration of Azure Queue streams, storage, and stream filters. The class also includes test cases that verify stream filtering behaviors such as ignoring bad filters and processing only even items.
